title: Model release evidence and pre-release migration policy
body:
## Outcome

Implement the reviewed release-evidence contract and durable legacy migration policy. A public repository with an actual GitHub Release, including a prerelease, is released. Other evidence is ambiguous unless an explicit reviewed project convention or owner declaration resolves it.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a plain-language policy section with provenance, review digest/history and user override.
- Classify public GitHub Release evidence as released; do not infer never-released from empty releases, absent tags or version strings. Missing, conflicting, unavailable or non-GitHub evidence becomes unknown and asks the user interactively or persists a blocker unattended.
- Permit the direct replacement/reset default only after an explicit reviewed owner declaration establishes never-released status. Scope any reset to affected project-owned state and preserve external/deployment authority.
- A first release invalidates the pre-release choice and requires review before affected incompatible changes; an approved released-project policy does not reprompt on every later release.
- Pure classifier and disposable fixtures cover positive public release, explicit never-released, ambiguous/failed evidence, first-release transition and preserved existing policy.

## First probe

Use a read-only repository/release fixture and inspect current policy/provenance seams before editing. The probe must distinguish a public GitHub Release from empty/unknown evidence without changing project state. Do not build a generic migration engine or perform a real reset.
